source.check: names and divisions read on the block image of the Banbridge Chronicle nominations report of 7 May 1927

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. In all seven electoral areas there was no opposition and the old members were returned unopposed, so there was no poll. Filed on the rural districts' polling day, Thursday 2 June 1927 (queue nominal 26 May). Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
